{{Short description|Russian mathematician (born 1950)}}
[[File:Gusein-zade.jpg|thumb|Sabir Gusein-Zade (2010), El Escorial]]

'''Sabir Medgidovich Gusein-Zade''' ({{langx|ru|Сабир Меджидович Гусейн-Заде}}; born 29 July 1950 in [[Moscow]]<ref name="HP">[https://www.mccme.ru/~sabir/ Home page of Sabir Gusein-Zade]</ref>) is a [[Russians|Russian]] mathematician and a specialist in [[singularity theory]] and its applications.<ref name="MMJ">{{citation
 | last1 = Artemov | first1 = S. B.
 | last2 = Belavin | first2 = A. A.

 | last12 = Margulis | first12 = G. A.
 | last13 = Neretin | first13 = Yu. A.
 | last14 = Novikov | first14 = S. P.
 | last15 = Shlosman | first15 = S. B.
 | last16 = Sossinsky | first16 = A. B.
 | last17 = Tsfasman | first17 = M. A.
 | last18 = Varchenko | first18 = A. N.
 | last19 = Vassiliev | first19 = V. A.

 | issue = 4
 | journal = [[Moscow Mathematical Journal]]
 | title = Sabir Medgidovich Gusein-Zade
 | url = http://www.ams.org/distribution/mmj/vol10-4-2010/gusein-zade.html

He studied at [[Moscow State University]], where he earned his Ph.D. in 1975 under the joint supervision of [[Sergei Novikov (mathematician)|Sergei Novikov]] and [[Vladimir Arnold]].<ref name="MGP">{{mathgenealogy|id=55263}}</ref> Before entering the university, he had earned a [[gold medal]] at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref name="MMJ" />

Gusein-Zade co-authored with V. I. Arnold and [[Alexander Varchenko|A. N. Varchenko]] the textbook ''Singularities of Differentiable Maps'' (published in English by [[Birkhäuser]]).<ref name="MMJ" />

A professor in both the Moscow State University and the [[Independent University of Moscow]], Gusein-Zade also serves as co-editor-in-chief for the ''[[Moscow Mathematical Journal]]''.<ref>{{citation|url=http://static.bsu.az/w24/sabir%20huseinzade60.pdf|journal=TWMS Journal of Pure and Applied Mathematics|volume=2|issue=1|year=2011|page=161|department=Anniversaries|title=Sabir Gusein-Zade – 60|author=Editorial Board}}.</ref> He shares credit with [[Norbert A'Campo]] for results on the singularities of plane curves.<ref>{{citation

==Selected publications==
*S. M. Gusein-Zade. "[https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF01075485?LI=true Dynkin diagrams for singularities of functions of two variables]". ''Functional Analysis and Its Applications'', 1974, Volume 8, Issue 4, pp.&nbsp;295–300.
*S. M. Gusein-Zade. "[https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF02028301?LI=true Intersection matrices for certain singularities of functions of two variables]". ''Functional Analysis and Its Applications'', 1974, Volume 8, Issue 1, pp.&nbsp;10–13.
*A. Campillo, F. Delgado, and S. M. Gusein-Zade. "[http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.dmj/1085598340 The Alexander polynomial of a plane curve singularity via the ring of functions on it]". ''Duke Mathematical Journal'', 2003, Volume 117, Number 1, pp.&nbsp;125–156.
*S. M. Gusein-Zade. "[http://epubs.siam.org/doi/abs/10.1137/1111050?journalCode=tprbau The problem of choice and the optimal stopping rule for a sequence of independent trials]". ''Theory of Probability & Its Applications'', 1965, Volume 11, Number 3, pp.&nbsp;472–476.
*S. M. Gusein-Zade. "[http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1559/152304093782637424#.VRY8SxrLIuk A new technique for constructing continuous cartograms]". ''Cartography and Geographic Information Systems'', 1993, Volume 20, Issue 3, pp.&nbsp;167–173.
